title: Contract Forms and Deferral Charge Periods on Home Purchase Financing Loans
content:
**Legal department note — deferral clauses of the Home Purchase Financing contract forms**

The deferral charge periods are the number of times the deferral percentage of the scheduled installment is charged in one deferment agreement. They turn on the contract form, which follows the date the loan was funded — the date the amount financed was advanced to the seller.

- Where the loan was funded on or after 2019-07-01, under the contract form whose deferral clause charges each deferred installment for every month it is moved, the deferral charge periods are the installments deferred times the installments deferred.
- Where the loan was funded before 2015-01-01, the deferral charge periods are one for the whole agreement.
- Loans funded from 2015-01-01 through 2019-06-30 are not varied by this note.

| Funding date | Deferral charge periods, 1 installment deferred | 2 installments deferred |
|---|---|---|
| on or after 2019-07-01 | 1 | 4 |
| before 2015-01-01 | 1 | 1 |
| 2015-01-01 through 2019-06-30 | not varied by this note | not varied by this note |

*Boundary.* A loan funded on 2019-07-01 is under the first form; one funded on 2019-06-30 is not. A loan funded on 2014-12-31 is under the second form; one funded on 2015-01-01 is not.

*Hypothetical figure.* With a scheduled installment of 705.00, a deferral rate of 1.00 percent and 2 installments deferred on a loan funded in 2021, the deferral charge is 705.00 times 1.00 divided by 100, times 4 periods, that is 28.20.
